title: kbmon --receipt prints needs you: 0 when the panels that hold asks and orphans were not read, so an unknown count reads as nothing waiting
goal: When a panel that can hold needs-you entries (coord, sessions, sprint, host) was not read, the receipt's needs-you part says the count is unknown for those panels (as mon_needs.line already does with 'nothing; not read: ...') instead of a number: today mon_receipt.needs_tail (_tools/mon_receipt.py) prints len(entries) over the panels read, so the session-start line of 2026-11-08 said 'needs you: 0 (not read: sprint, sessions, host, coord)' while the coord store held five open asks.

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--receipt','--timeout','3'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode not in (0,1) or 'needs you: 0 (not read' in r.stdout)
